findings.title: CWD-relative env_file paths silently skip .env when CWD is not repo root
findings.problem: env_file=('.env', '.env.local') uses bare relative paths resolved against process CWD at Config() instantiation. The replaced find_dotenv() walked up the directory tree from the calling file and returned an absolute path. If CWD is not the repo root at startup (Docker with WORKDIR=/app/src, pytest run from a subdirectory, Celery worker, IDE test runner), neither file resolves and all settings silently default — pydantic-settings emits no error or warning. The Config class already uses Path(__file__).absolute().parents[3] for every other config-file path.
findings.impact: Silent config regression: API keys, database URLs, feature flags, and model provider settings fall back to Python defaults. The service starts cleanly and fails on the first real request with no diagnostic indicating missing config.
findings.recommendation: Anchor to __file__ using the pattern already established in Config: _REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).absolute().parents[3] (class-level constant); model_config = SettingsConfigDict(env_file=(str(_REPO_ROOT / '.env'), str(_REPO_ROOT / '.env.local')), extra='ignore'). Confirmed consistent with how all other config-file paths are resolved in Config.

findings.title: os.makedirs not mocked in test_tar_logs_warning_when_env_absent — filesystem side effects and platform-sensitive failure
findings.problem: CodemieExportService.tar() calls os.makedirs(cls.tmp_state_dir) before reaching the env-file check path. The test does not mock os.makedirs, so a real directory is created on disk during each test run. If makedirs fails (PermissionError, missing /tmp on Windows, unexpected CWD), the exception is swallowed by contextlib.suppress(Exception) and mock_logger.warning is never called, causing assert_called_once() to fail with a misleading AssertionError that hides the actual cause.
findings.impact: Flaky test on CI/Windows environments where /tmp behavior differs; real filesystem side effects on every test run; misleading assertion failure obscures the root cause (makedirs, not the missing warning).
findings.recommendation: Add patch('codemie.service.codemie_export_service.os.makedirs') to the mock context alongside the existing patches. This prevents real directory creation, ensures the code path always reaches the warning branch regardless of platform, and eliminates the filesystem side effect.
